name: EXM_CC_UPLOAD_RULES
description: This table contains the rules applied to a corporate card transaction file upload, such as employee matching rule and automatic expense type derivation rule.

columns.name: CC_UPLOAD_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the upload rule for a corporate card program.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card program.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_CP_DEFAULTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether to use company account-specific upload rules.

columns.name: FILE_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Format of the file provided by the corporate card issuer, such as GL 1025 and CDF3.

columns.name: DETAIL_WAITING_DURATION
columns.description: Maximum number of days the application waits for transaction details before the transaction can be used in an expense report.

columns.name: CARD_EMP_MATCHING_RULE
columns.description: Rule used to automatically assign employees defined in the application to new corporate cards that arrive in the charge file.

columns.name: CC_EXP_TYP_SUM_SOURCE_COL
columns.description: Column in EXM_CREDIT_CARD_TRXNS table that stores the expense types, or merchant category codes, that come in the charge file for the summary transactions. The application applies the summary mapping rule to this column.

columns.name: CC_EXP_TYP_SUM_MAP_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the mapping rule that automatically populates expense type for summary transactions.

columns.name: CC_EXP_TYP_DTL_SOURCE_COL
columns.description: Column in EXM_CC_TRXN_DETAILS table that stores the expense types, or merchant category codes, that come in the charge file for the detail transactions. The application applies the detail mapping rule to this column.

columns.name: CC_EXP_TYP_DTL_MAP_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the mapping rule that automatically populates expense type for detail transactions.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: MATCH_EMPLOYEE_ACROSS_BU
columns.description: When this column is set to Y, employees are matched across all business units for assigning new corporate cards that arrive in the charge file.
